limitations: The official product data supplies geometry, mass, loading and certification, not a complete aerodynamic polar.
Performance targets, brake pressure, handling, collapse and recovery parameters are simulator research estimates.
Exact line geometry, structural deformation and manoeuvre response require manufacturer cooperation and instrumented validation.
Manufacturer identity, trade dress and visual design require permission before commercial release.
